summary: Compiler architecture and implementation plan for the A100 correctness-only run, derived from the 56 recorded facts, the workload feature matrix and the 107-construct api-spec. (1) docs/compiler-agent/COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE.md (mirrored at the project root where the engine reads it): two verified IRs (TIR tir/v1 carrying width/signedness, conversion-vs-bitcast, mask defaults, broadcast extents, reduction/dot contracts, runtime-symbolic launch geometry; MIR mir/v1 carrying vsetvli regions, masked memory ops, IME tile ops with the sourced operand contract, worker partition and stage structure) plus the emitted program-level assembly artifact; frontend with the declared-surface table, meta-tier specialization identity (shapes/grid/values runtime, never baked) and a provenance-tracked case-layer grid model emitted as a native runtime grid evaluation; the six basic optimization passes as normal pipeline work; execution planning with 1/2/4/8-worker partitioning, stage barriers, merge semantics and workspace ownership; RVV masked-tail handling; IME lowering for INT8 8x16x8 (smt.vmadot) and FP16 8x8x8 (smt.vfwmadot, FP32 accumulation) with register grouping constraints and the BF16 emulator gap handled by the vector FP32 path; repertoire-as-data backend with legalisation, one generic selection matcher, interference-based allocation over the 32x128B vector file; precompiled native C runtime (pool, barriers, a100-native-io/v1 bundle reader, --repeats with input restore); driver with artifact cache identity covering every bound dependency and the A100_COMPILER_FACTORY=a100c.factory:make_compiler integration through a100_support/native_device.py; per-stage dumps for first-incorrect-stage localisation. (2) ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINTS.json (root + docs mirror): schema_version 1, test_command 'python3 {test}', 43 responsibility-owned modules, 10 stages with tests, 2 IR levels with the six basic passes declared, cfg/register_allocation symbol contracts, 4 behaviour entries including the required no-operator-name-dispatch role with a must-fail witness, 24 validation checks - validates under architecture-check --declaration-only with zero errors. (3) EXECUTION_MODEL.json recorded via the execution-model command (work unit, workers 1..8 configurable, mechanism, 4 partition policies, 3 synchronization entries, safety condition, serial fallback, evidence citing F016/F018/F019/F043/F053/F054). (4) EXECUTION_RESOURCES.json (root + docs mirror): 8 a100-compute-worker-slot units derived from F053/F019, minimum_workers 2, instruction_patterns smt.vmadot + smt.vfwmadot passing the A100 matrix-compute witness, 14 active-fact citations, 3 shared-resource groups (IME-2.0 engine, cluster L2, cluster scratchpad) each citing active facts. (5) Implementation DAG T005-T022 submitted through task-submit: runtime+ABI first (hand-written artifact witness), frontend core, the G4-tagged vertical slice (T007, one-worker and multi-worker paths on one artifact, ragged-tail witness), control flow/grid generality, reductions/merges, the IME slice with real counted smt.* executions before matrix breadth, memory/atomics, layout/conversions, math/RNG, matrix breadth, the basic passes as coding/input work, frontend coverage recording, driver/factory/generality checks, G6 compile sweep, G7 full scan, parallel+resource evidence, repeated-call/synchronization validation, G8 final regression - no capability/purpose/tag optimization, no G9, no corpus narrowing. Planning created no compiler modules.
